fixture_note: Showing the checked-in reference data, not this project.
band_state_label: Every feature, ordered by whose move it is
band_claim_label: How the codebase is claimed: {core} core, {platform} platform, {tests} tests, {unclaimed} unclaimed
claimed_share: of the codebase a feature claims
no_matches_subtitle: Clear the filter to see the whole roster.
list_unclaimed_subtitle: Code no declared feature reaches, and that is not tests and not platform. This is the page's to-do list.
list_untouched_subtitle: Whole groups no feature's slice enters.
list_loadbearing_subtitle: Three or more features go through each of these.
list_shared_title: Shared services the map does not name
list_shared_none: The board does not carry these yet, so nothing is listed rather than a guess.
pick_subtitle: Choose one on the left to read its rating, its slice and its branches.
rose_label: The council's members, their weights and their scores
drifted_note: Approved, and the code has moved since.
cta_decision_note: The decision itself is made on the Council page.
tier_toggle_hint: Only a major feature reaches the human gate.
scenarios_subtitle: A feature certified as a whole can still behave differently by branch.
envelope_none: No branch has been measured yet.
score_bar_unmeasured: Not measured, against a floor of {floor}
advisory_note: A floor was hit by an instrument that has not earned the authority yet, so it flags and does not fail.
proposed_subtitle: A member named this branch. Nobody has ruled on it, and it moves no number until someone does.
field_title_hint: The branch in the user's words, for example "Marketing candidates".
field_axes_hint: What varies, as name and value. For example candidate_family and marketing.
field_floor_hint: The score this branch must hold. Only a must-hold branch is failed by it.
scenario_delete_body: The scenario and every result that judged it are removed. This cannot be undone.
scenarios_none_subtitle: Declare a branch and the council judges it separately, turning one approval into an envelope.
unreadable_title: The board could not be read
never_scanned_title: Features exist, but none is linked to a context yet
never_scanned_subtitle: Nothing has been sliced, so nothing can be claimed. Re-link the features to the context map and the board fills in.
no_features_subtitle: Scan the codebase and the features it declares land here with the contexts each one claims.
no_project_subtitle: Pick a project above and its features load.
